recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-13566 unless a future tracker changes the useContext search-parameter model.
issue_request: FHIR-13566 was a Published STU3 CDS change request with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to add useContext search support to ActivityDefinition and resolved to add multi-parameter useContext searching, including examples for gender and age-range filtering and related application to Library and Measure.
initial_application: The change was originally applied in SVN revision 12616, imported as Git commit bc0e408c80a3d8ff7d558e023496ecffd4d76e7b with subject '#13565, #13566: Adding search by useContext type and value to MetadataResource.' The Jira comment specifically says context-quantity, context-type, context-type-value, and context-type-quantity were added to MetadataResource.
additional_context: FHIR-13565 is the PlanDefinition sibling applied in the same implementation commit. FHIR-17245 later documented inconsistent inheritance of the MetadataResource useContext search parameters and was resolved as Published/Persuasive by ensuring they were applied consistently. Current fhir.ini build-scope entries list ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, Library, Measure, and MetadataResource as active resources/abbreviations.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/activitydefinition/bundle-ActivityDefinition-search-params.xml already defines context, context-quantity, context-type, context-type-quantity, and context-type-value over ActivityDefinition.useContext, and the Library, Measure, and PlanDefinition search-parameter bundles contain matching current useContext search families.
